scope: Actual browser-issued PostgreSQL snapshots, durable Supabase acceptance to callback confirmation; both timestamps from the same database clock. Not synthetic MQTT transport or browser paint latency.
query_filter: command.type=snapshot, accepted_at>=2026-11-20T08:54:00Z, result.status=snapshot, confirmed_at not null
interpretation: P50 is descriptive. P95 has very few tail observations and is exploratory; no reliable P95/P99 service target is established from this sample. Individual actual write/browser confirmation and controlled fault recovery are reported separately.
